Project handover notes
Introduction
This document records the handover for the release.
It is intentionally short and easy to diff.
Build
<<<<<<< left
The build runs on the release runner.
||||||| base
The build runs on the shared runner.
=======
The build runs on the nightly runner.
>>>>>>> right
Artefacts are archived after every build.
Tests
Unit tests cover the merge helpers.
End-to-end tests drive the real window.
Deployment
Deployments go out on weekday mornings.
The rollback plan is rehearsed quarterly.
Contacts
The release lead owns the checklist.
The platform team owns the runner.
Notes
Fixtures are committed, not generated.
Keep the diff small and readable.
History
First published for the merge view work.
Reviewers
Two reviewers approve every merge.
Accessibility
Every control has an accessible name.
Localisation
Strings live in the shared catalogue.
Support
<<<<<<< left
The support rota is published weekly.
||||||| base
The support rota is published monthly.
=======
The support rota is published daily.
>>>>>>> right
Security
Reports go to the security mailbox.
Thanks to the release team.
End of document.
